plugins.description: Community toolkit for authoring Minder product plugins against the public plugin-sdk / plugin-template (scaffold, SDK-contract validation, protocol + security review) plus the MinderHQ development queue — an autonomous, controlled loop that implements ready minderhq issues one at a time as focused PRs.
